title: Valid transfer file
blurb: A pain.001.001.09 credit transfer generated by the API: structured addresses, one invoice reference and one RF creditor reference. Every check passes.

title: Old file, wrong total
blurb: A 2009 pain.001.001.03 file whose header control sum has two digits swapped. A German bank may reject the whole file for this.
input:

issues.message: The message control sum is 1248.06; the amounts add up to 1284.06.

pain.001.001.03 is the 2009 version. Banks are moving to the 2019 versions (pain.001.001.09 / pain.008.001.08); German banks' specification limited the old version to November 2025. Use /v1/convert to migrate the file.

title: Direct debit, two errors
blurb: A pain.008.001.02 direct debit with a mistyped creditor identifier and a mandate dated in the future.
input:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document xmlns="urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.008.001.02">
  <CstmrDrctDbtInitn>
    <GrpHdr>
      <MsgId>DD-2026-10-20-1</MsgId>
      <CreDtTm>2026-10-20T10:00:00</CreDtTm>
      <NbOfTxs>1</NbOfTxs>
      <CtrlSum>25.00</CtrlSum>
      <InitgPty><Nm>Sportverein Musterstadt e.V.</Nm></InitgPty>
    </GrpHdr>
    <PmtInf>
      <PmtInfId>DD-2026-10-20-1-RCUR</PmtInfId>
      <PmtMtd>DD</PmtMtd>
      <NbOfTxs>1</NbOfTxs>
      <CtrlSum>25.00</CtrlSum>
      <PmtTpInf>
        <SvcLvl><Cd>SEPA</Cd></SvcLvl>
        <LclInstrm><Cd>CORE</Cd></LclInstrm>
        <SeqTp>RCUR</SeqTp>
      </PmtTpInf>
      <ReqdColltnDt>2026-11-02</ReqdColltnDt>
      <Cdtr><Nm>Sportverein Musterstadt e.V.</Nm></Cdtr>
      <CdtrAcct><Id><IBAN>DE89370400440532013000</IBAN></Id></CdtrAcct>
      <CdtrAgt><FinInstnId><BIC>COBADEFFXXX</BIC></FinInstnId></CdtrAgt>
      <ChrgBr>SLEV</ChrgBr>
      <CdtrSchmeId>
        <Id><PrvtId><Othr><Id>DE98ZZZ09999999990</Id><SchmeNm><Prtry>SEPA</Prtry></SchmeNm></Othr></PrvtId></Id>
      </CdtrSchmeId>
      <DrctDbtTxInf>
        <PmtId><EndToEndId>MEMBER-0001-2026-11</EndToEndId></PmtId>
        <InstdAmt Ccy="EUR">25.00</InstdAmt>
        <DrctDbtTx><MndtRltdInf><MndtId>M-001</MndtId><DtOfSgntr>2026-12-01</DtOfSgntr></MndtRltdInf></DrctDbtTx>
        <DbtrAgt><FinInstnId><Othr><Id>NOTPROVIDED</Id></Othr></FinInstnId></DbtrAgt>
        <Dbtr><Nm>Anna Schmidt</Nm></Dbtr>
        <DbtrAcct><Id><IBAN>DE02120300000000202051</IBAN></Id></DbtrAcct>
        <RmtInf><Ustrd>Membership November</Ustrd></RmtInf>
      </DrctDbtTxInf>
    </PmtInf>
  </CstmrDrctDbtInitn>

issues.message: 'DE98ZZZ09999999990' is not a valid SEPA creditor identifier.
The mandate signature date is in the future.

pain.008.001.02 is the 2009 version. Banks are moving to the 2019 versions (pain.001.001.09 / pain.008.001.08); German banks' specification limited the old version to November 2025. Use /v1/convert to migrate the file.
